sources.summary: Nereidas Design House is an architectural project located within the desert landscape of Baja California. Situated near Todos Santos, it occupies a six-hundred-square-meter site characterized by sculptural cacti and uninterrupted views of the Sierra de la Laguna Mountains and the Pacific Ocean.
